title: Hiring Red, White & You! Veterans Job Fair Returns to Laredo Thursday
excerpt: The 15th annual Hiring Red, White & You! statewide hiring fair comes to Laredo on Thursday, Nov. 19, from 9 a.m. to 1 p.m. at the Falcon Bank Event Center, with more than 50 employers taking part.
content:
The 15th annual Hiring Red, White & You! statewide hiring fair returns to Laredo on Thursday, Nov. 19, from 9 a.m. to 1 p.m. at the Falcon Bank Event Center, 7718 McPherson Road, Building D, according to Workforce Solutions for South Texas.

The fair connects transitioning service members, military spouses, National Guard and Reserve members, veterans and their families with employers, and there is no cost to employers, according to the organizers: the Texas Workforce Commission, Workforce Solutions, the Texas Medical Center and the Texas Veterans Commission.

Veterans get priority entrance from 9 to 10 a.m., and the fair opens to the general public from 10 a.m. to 1 p.m., according to Workforce Solutions.

More than 50 employers and providers are listed as taking part, including the City of Laredo, Concentrix, Doctors Hospital of Laredo, Laredo College, the Laredo Police Department, LISD, UISD, TAMIU, the South Texas Food Bank, U.S. Border Patrol/Customs and Border Protection, and Webb County Human Resources.

Job seekers who need help can text the word JOBS to (888) 984-4826, according to Workforce Solutions.

Source: Workforce Solutions for South Texas.
